Meet Timi

I’m a Nigerian filmmaker and cinematographer based in Lagos. On set, I work with light, framing and camera movement to find the right way into a scene. I shoot everything from interviews and performances to brand films and documentaries. I can handle the camera myself or bring in a crew when the shoot calls for one.

I also direct and edit, so I’m thinking about how the footage will cut while I’m still shooting it. I’m the founder of Genius Creative Brands, a Pan-African creative and media group working across multiple creative industries.

From the first frame
to the final cut,
I’m your guy.

From enquiry to final delivery.

  1. Tell Me About Your Project

    Send an enquiry with a description of what you want to create, your objectives, timeline and any available references.

  2. Get a Proposal

    I'll review the requirements and provide a quotation covering the scope, deliverables, timeline and production costs.

  3. Confirm Your Booking

    A 50% deposit is required to secure a booking unless otherwise agreed in writing. The booking is confirmed once payment and the necessary arrangements are completed.

  4. Production Begins

    We move into the agreed creative and production process, keeping communication clear throughout the project.

  5. Review & Delivery

    You'll receive the agreed deliverables for review. Final files are released after the outstanding balance has been paid.

Frequently asked questions

Where are you based?

I’m based in Lagos, Nigeria. I travel regularly and I’m available for shoots across Nigeria and internationally.

Do you work outside Lagos?

Yes. I work outside Lagos and will include travel and accommodation in the quote where applicable.

Can I hire you for just one service?

Yes. You can book me for an individual service, including cinematography, directing, photography, editing or mobile content creation.

Can you handle an entire production?

Yes. I own multiple production companies and lead several production teams. If you need a full team, I can bring the right people on and coordinate the creative work and production from development to delivery.

Are your prices fixed?

Published prices are starting rates. I’ll confirm the final quote based on your brief, the scope and any specific requests.

What do you shoot with?

I choose the camera and equipment based on what the shoot needs and what your budget allows. I can keep the setup lean for a small budget or put together a full cinema package and crew. If you have a particular camera in mind, let’s talk about it.

How do I secure a booking?

A 50% deposit is required to secure a booking unless another payment arrangement has been agreed.

Do you offer revisions?

Yes. Editing packages include up to two reasonable revision rounds per deliverable. Additional revisions or changes to the original brief may attract additional fees.

How long does delivery take?

Turnaround time depends on the project scope and is confirmed in the quotation or production agreement.
